content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.

arguments.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 520" width="640" height="520" role="img" aria-label="An anteater riding a unicycle while juggling three bottles">
  <title>Anteater Unicycle Juggler</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="640" height="520" fill="#fdf3e3"/>
  <circle cx="548" cy="78" r="34" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85">
    <ellipse cx="120" cy="80" rx="42" ry="16"/>
    <ellipse cx="155" cy="70" rx="30" ry="13"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="120" rx="36" ry="13"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect y="440" width="640" height="80" fill="#e9d8b8"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="440" x2="640" y2="440" stroke="#c9b48a" stroke-width="4"/>

  <!-- Shadow (pulses with the bob) -->
  <ellipse cx="320" cy="446" rx="95" ry="10" fill="#00000022">
    <animate attributeName="rx" values="95;82;95" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </ellipse>

  <!-- ===== UNICYCLE (stays on ground) ===== -->
  <g>
    <!-- Wheel -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="320" cy="380" r="60" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="10"/>
      <circle cx="320" cy="380" r="52" fill="none" stroke="#888" stroke-width="3"/>
      <!-- Spokes spin -->
      <g stroke="#666" stroke-width="4">
        <line x1="320" y1="326" x2="320" y2="434"/>
        <line x1="266" y1="380" x2="374" y2="380"/>
        <line x1="282" y1="342" x2="358" y2="418"/>
        <line x1="358" y1="342" x2="282" y2="418"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 320 380" to="360 320 380" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="320" cy="380" r="9" fill="#333"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Fork + seat post -->
    <path d="M 296 350 L 320 380 L 344 350" fill="none" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="380" x2="320" y2="292" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="8"/>
    <!-- Seat -->
    <path d="M 292 292 Q 320 278 348 292 L 344 300 L 296 300 Z" fill="#5b3a29"/>

    <!-- Pedals + cranks rotating around hub -->
    <g>
      <line x1="320" y1="380" x2="320" y2="348" stroke="#333" stroke-width="6"/>
      <line x1="320" y1="380" x2="320" y2="412" stroke="#333" stroke-width="6"/>
      <rect x="304" y="342" width="32" height="9" rx="3" fill="#222"/>
      <rect x="304" y="409" width="32" height="9" rx="3" fill="#222"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 320 380" to="360 320 380" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== ANTEATER + JUGGLING (whole rider bobs gently) ===== -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -6; 0 0" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- Bushy tail, swishing -->
    <g>
      <path d="M 268 268 Q 200 250 178 300 Q 160 345 205 352 Q 190 320 218 300 Q 240 285 272 292 Z" fill="#6d5843"/>
      <path d="M 262 276 Q 215 268 200 305" fill="none" stroke="#8a7358" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-6 270 280; 8 270 280; -6 270 280" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Legs pedaling (simple alternating pump) -->
    <g stroke="#7a6248" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
      <path d="M 300 285 Q 296 320 312 348">
        <animate attributeName="d" values="M 300 285 Q 296 320 312 348; M 300 285 Q 288 330 316 410; M 300 285 Q 296 320 312 348" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
      <path d="M 336 285 Q 344 330 326 410">
        <animate attributeName="d" values="M 336 285 Q 344 330 326 410; M 336 285 Q 342 320 328 348; M 336 285 Q 344 330 326 410" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
    </g>

    <!-- Body: classic anteater hump with diagonal band -->
    <path d="M 262 290 Q 258 218 316 208 Q 372 200 388 246 Q 396 276 372 292 Q 316 306 262 290 Z" fill="#8a7358"/>
    <path d="M 286 214 Q 330 206 356 226 L 322 296 Q 296 296 276 288 Z" fill="#2f2a26"/>
    <path d="M 292 216 Q 330 210 350 226 L 344 240 Q 316 222 296 228 Z" fill="#f4ede1"/>

    <!-- Head + long snout, nodding slightly -->
    <g>
      <path d="M 366 232 Q 396 210 416 224 Q 470 246 508 268 Q 512 274 506 278 Q 462 268 414 258 Q 388 254 372 252 Z" fill="#8a7358"/>
      <path d="M 470 254 Q 492 262 508 268 Q 512 274 506 278 Q 488 274 468 268 Z" fill="#4a3b2c"/>
      <circle cx="398" cy="234" r="5" fill="#221a12"/>
      <circle cx="400" cy="232" r="1.6" fill="#fff"/>
      <!-- Ear -->
      <path d="M 372 216 Q 376 200 388 208 Q 390 218 380 222 Z" fill="#6d5843"/>
      <!-- Tongue flick! -->
      <path d="M 508 272 q 14 2 22 -4" fill="none" stroke="#e26d6d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0;1;1;0" keyTimes="0;0.55;0.65;0.85;1" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 372 244; 3 372 244; 0 372 244" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Arms raised for juggling -->
    <g stroke="#7a6248" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
      <path d="M 300 236 Q 272 210 262 182">
        <animate attributeName="d" values="M 300 236 Q 272 210 262 182; M 300 236 Q 270 216 258 190; M 300 236 Q 272 210 262 182" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
      <path d="M 352 232 Q 380 206 392 178">
        <animate attributeName="d" values="M 352 232 Q 380 206 392 178; M 352 232 Q 384 212 396 186; M 352 232 Q 380 206 392 178" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
    </g>
    <!-- Paws -->
    <circle cx="262" cy="182" r="9" fill="#5b4a36">
      <animate attributeName="cy" values="182;190;182" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="262;258;262" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="392" cy="178" r="9" fill="#5b4a36">
      <animate attributeName="cy" values="178;186;178" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="392;396;392" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>

    <!-- ===== JUGGLING BOTTLES: 3-bottle cascade ===== -->
    <!-- Each bottle follows the same figure-loop path, offset by 0.6s -->
    <defs>
      <g id="bottle">
        <rect x="-9" y="-14" width="18" height="30" rx="6" fill="#3fa66a" stroke="#2c7a4b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <rect x="-4" y="-26" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#3fa66a" stroke="#2c7a4b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <rect x="-5" y="-30" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#d4a017"/>
        <rect x="-6" y="-6" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="#f4ede1"/>
      </g>
    </defs>

    <g>
      <use href="#bottle">
        <animateMotion dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto"
          path="M 262 168 C 250 60, 390 60, 392 164 C 394 190, 340 190, 328 168 C 316 60, 250 60, 262 168 Z"/>
      </use>
      <use href="#bottle">
        <animateMotion dur="1.8s" begin="-0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto"
          path="M 262 168 C 250 60, 390 60, 392 164 C 394 190, 340 190, 328 168 C 316 60, 250 60, 262 168 Z"/>
      </use>
      <use href="#bottle">
        <animateMotion dur="1.8s" begin="-1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto"
          path="M 262 168 C 250 60, 390 60, 392 164 C 394 190, 340 190, 328 168 C 316 60, 250 60, 262 168 Z"/>
      </use>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Motion sparkles near wheel -->
  <g stroke="#c9b48a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="230" y1="420" x2="210" y2="420">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;1" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </line>
    <line x1="238" y1="432" x2="212" y2="432">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </line>
  </g>
</svg>

content.text:
Created **`anteater-unicycle-juggler.svg`** — a fully self-contained animated SVG (SMIL, no JS needed). Open it in any browser to see:

- 🎡 **Spinning unicycle wheel** with rotating spokes and pedaling cranks/pedals
- 🦫 **Anteater rider** with the classic humped back, diagonal black-and-white band, long snout, bushy swishing tail, and an occasional tongue flick
- 🦵 Legs pumping in sync with the pedals, arms bobbing as they toss
- 🍾 **Three green bottles** juggling in a proper cascade pattern (figure-loop `animateMotion` paths offset by 0.6s each)
- Gentle whole-body bob, pulsing ground shadow, and speed lines for extra life

All animations loop indefinitely and are synced to a 1.2s pedal cycle.
